name: io.github.anon5376/agent-communication-system
title: Agent Communication System (qagent)
description: Local-first coordination bus for coding agents: mail, task queues, review gates — one SQLite file.

environmentVariables.name: QAGENT_AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent identity registered in the bus via `qagent agent add`. The agent's token file must already exist under the bus home.

environmentVariables.name: QAGENT_BUS_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the bus SQLite file. Defaults to ~/.agent-bus/bus.db.
